ائتمروا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَرُوا (iʔtamarū) /iʔ.ta.ma.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# اِئْتَمِرُوا (iʔtamirū) /iʔ.ta.mi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
